prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: serv-alu-lut
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 4517ef6a46dbd2d7
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
o_rd/result_bool with bo=01 and rs1==op_b returns 1 while the trace expects 0 for both rs1=op_b=0 and rs1=op_b=1. Unequal-operand bo=01 cases already read 0 and all bo=00/10/11 cases pass. Root cause is BOOL_LUT=16'h8E96 whose bo=01 nibble is 0x9 (equality/XNOR) so equal inputs index a 1 instead of required 0.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 4517ef6a46dbd2d7 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
